retrospective.harder_than_needed: Confirming AC-PROD-1/DD-8's call-site boundary required more than reading the story's declared file list: a grep for 'InviteMemberModal' across the app turned up a second file, pages/profile.tsx, which does NOT render the component or call submitInviteWithMarker — the hit was a docstring cross-reference to a wholly separate hand-duplicated implementation (addToGroupWithMarker/handleAddToGroup) of the same direct-invite semantics. Verifying that this second surface was genuinely out of AC-PROD-1's wording (rather than a call site the story silently needed to cover) took an extra investigation pass before implementation could proceed with confidence.
retrospective.surprised_by: pages/profile.tsx's 'Add to group' action reimplements the exact same direct-invite flow (inviteByNpub + pending-marker bookkeeping) as InviteMemberModal.tsx's submitInviteWithMarker, in a fully separate function this story's producer wiring cannot reach. The same product action (A directly invites a known contact) will now emit the invited announcement from the group page's invite modal but silently not from the profile page's Add-to-group button. AC-PROD-1's wording scopes exactly to submitInviteWithMarker/InviteMemberModal, so this is not a defect in this story, but it is a real product-behavior inconsistency. Filed as VQ-S2-009 (post-impl, appended to verification.json) rather than fixed here, since profile.tsx is outside this story's declared file scope and duplicating/threading the producer there would be scope creep beyond S2's file list.
